pointOfInterests.description:
From a comment:

"If you paddle from Westerlo to the power lines that cross the creek and Red Mill Rd. in Greenville, it's nice and you can see what's coming--just stay awake and scout.
pointOfInterests.name: Red Mill Rd. Takeout

alerts.detail: I tried this route April 5. There are between 6-8 dangerous strainers. I would not recommend trying it.

detail.description:

See the Directions and Flows tabs for more info.
